parallels.note: So Yahweh turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.

translations.web: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turns from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.
translations.bsb: But if that nation I warned turns from its evil, then I will relent of the disaster I had planned to bring.
translations.kjv: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do
